refused: The authorization did not go through
authorized_but_drive: Your assistant is authorized, except in Drive
other_account: This link is for another account
other_account_text: This link authorizes the assistant of {owner}, but this browser is signed in to Twake as {signed_in}: nothing was saved. Open this link in a private window, then sign in as {owner}.
space_intro: For it to read your Twake Space spaces and their feeds, and manage their members, create an API token for it in Twake Space, then paste it here.
space_kept: A token is already saved, pasted on {day}. {allows}
space_kept_choice: Keep it, remove it, or replace it: create another API token in Twake Space, then paste it here.
steps_open: page of Twake Space, then click “Create a token”.
steps: What it can do: Spaces “Write”, Activity feed “Read”, Members “Write”, API tokens “No access”.
Spaces it reaches: “All spaces”, that is “All my spaces, including the ones I join later”.
Copy the token, which Twake Space shows only once, then paste it below.
scopes_needed: It needs “Read spaces” and “Read feeds”. Without “Change spaces”, it creates and renames no space; without “Manage members”, it adds and removes no one.

may_act.granted: Your Twake Space assistant can now act for {user}, Drive included.
may_act.absent: Your Twake Space assistant can now act for {user}. Drive is not available for your account.
may_act.unchanged: Your Twake Space assistant can still act for {user}. Its access to Drive does not change.
may_act.without: Your Twake Space assistant can now act for {user}, but not in Drive. {reason}

without_drive.declined: You did not grant access to your files.
without_drive.refused: Your Drive instance refused the authorization code.
without_drive.unavailable: Your Drive instance could not complete the authorization.

space_after.skipped: Without an API token, it does not act in your Twake Space spaces.
space_after.kept: In your Twake Space spaces, it keeps the API token you had pasted.
space_after.pasted: In your Twake Space spaces, it acts with the token you pasted.
space_after.removed: It no longer acts in your Twake Space spaces: the API token you had pasted is removed. Revoke it too on the “API tokens” page of Twake Space.

allows_some: This token allows: {held}. It does not allow: {lacking}.

reasons.none_in_progress: No authorization is in progress in this browser.
reasons.not_in_progress: This page does not match the authorization in progress.
reasons.no_longer_in_progress: This authorization is no longer in progress.
reasons.lemonldap_declined: LemonLDAP did not grant the authorization.
reasons.lemonldap_unavailable: LemonLDAP could not complete the authorization.
reasons.offline_access_denied: LemonLDAP did not grant the assistant offline access.

problems.not_a_token: This token was not saved: it is not a Twake Space API token, which starts with tws_.
problems.refused: This token was not saved: Twake Space does not recognize it. Copy all of it, or create another one if it was revoked or has expired.
problems.too_broad: This token was not saved: it allows “Manage tokens”, so if it leaked it could create others. Create another one, with API tokens “No access”.
problems.scopes_missing: This token was not saved: it needs at least “Read spaces” and “Read feeds”. {allows}
problems.not_theirs: This token was not saved: it is an organization token or another account's: in at least one of the spaces it reaches, it does not act as you. Create your own in Twake Space, signed in as {user}.
problems.unavailable: This token was not saved: Twake Space could not check it. Try again in a moment.
